title: Rooted+
description: Adds balanced vanilla+ recipes to help builders with both time, and inventory efficiency
body:
![Rooted+ by _macket](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa5c7b9a260d1a5cc447f3fe62a17d8834693b67.png)

## 

**Rooted+** aims to add _balanced_, _vanilla+_ recipes to allow for a better _inventory management_ system and _quality of life_ experience. For example you can use the stonecutter to switch between the majority of Stone Bricks' variants, and then turn them straight back into regular Stone Bricks to _save space_ in your inventories.

Currently **Rooted+** is only developed for ~14 block families, however I have many more features planned for future updates.\
This is a passion project made by one person, so please bare that in mind when it comes to updates.

<details>
<summary>Future Plans</summary>

**v0.2** ▪ Extra Masonry Update - _Miscellaneous blocks (Bricks, Mud, Resin)_\
**v0.3** ▪ Blacksmith Update - _Copper & Iron recipes (plus oxidisation)_\
**v0.4** ▪ Carpenters Update - _Wood recipes_\
**v0.5** ▪ Painters Update - _Choose specific paintings_\
**v0.6** ▪ Unpacking Update - __Unpacking blocks like Wool into 4 String_
